data.analysis_policy: Use all 14599 original genes in the additive condition+type bulk-count model; exact metadata file identities remove suffix fb, not row position. Unshrunk treated/reference log2FC, Wald zero-null testing, Cook filtering on, no independent filtering or count replacement. For this audit, a gene is testable exactly when its log-fold-change coefficient fit converged and its Cook-filtered Wald p-value is finite/non-null; finite p alone does not qualify a nonconverged fit. BH over every gene satisfying this definition. Upregulated point-estimate screen: gene BH q<=0.05 and log2FC>=1 (not a formal minimum-effect test). The set universe is every testable gene, not only annotated or selected genes. Use only non-negated annotations in the declared experimental evidence set; match exact GO IDs, without ontology propagation. Deduplicate gene/term pairs; ignore and report genes outside the universe. For each of the six declared terms test the one-sided overrepresentation tail and apply BH over all six terms, including empty categories. Return all terms at q<=0.05 and all leading q ties within 1e-12.
data.claim_scope: Archived Drosophila observational count and annotation association only; exact-term direct annotations are not all descendants of a GO category, and enrichment is not mechanistic, causal or localization proof. An annotation date newer than the count package is a declared retrospective reannotation, not historical preregistration.
